levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Completes one or two of the three parts.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Completes all three parts and adds a relevant fourth check on their own.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The next morning still had a preventable problem.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The next morning went smoothly because of the prep.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: The next morning went smoothly and the learner names the specific link between one prep step and one smooth outcome.

lookFors: All three routine parts are named specifically, not vaguely.
Independent attempt happens without the adult doing any part for the learner.
Reflection makes a specific before/after comparison.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
